findings.evidence: In `pkg/expression/column.go`, `(*Column).Hash64` hashes `col.RetType.Hash64(h)` but `(*Column).Equals` uses `col.RetType.Equal(col2.RetType)`. In `pkg/parser/types/field_type.go`, `(*FieldType).Hash64` hashes the full `flag`, `flen`, and `decimal`, while `(*FieldType).Equal` intentionally ignores most flags (only compares unsigned) and may ignore `decimal`/`flen` depending on eval type.
findings.fix: Align the pair so `Equals` implies identical `Hash64`: either (1) change `(*Column).Equals` to use `RetType.Equals` (strict, consistent with `Hash64`), or (2) change `(*Column).Hash64` to hash only the subset of FieldType properties used by `RetType.Equal` (including its special-case rules). Apply the same alignment to `CorrelatedColumn` since it delegates to `Column.Equals`.
findings.impact: Any hash-based equivalence/memoization that buckets by `Hash64` and resolves conflicts via `Equals` (the documented purpose of cascades/base.HashEquals) can miss matches: two Columns that `Equals` deems equal may land in different hash buckets. This can break lookup/dedup invariants in planner hash tables, causing unstable optimization behavior and potential planner blowups.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Checked `upstream/master` (`pkg/expression/column.go` at 3b531d4e3d): `Column.Equals` still uses `RetType.Equal` while `Column.Hash64` hashes `RetType.Hash64`, so the mismatch remains.
findings.verify: Add a unit test creating two Columns identical except for a RetType flag that `FieldType.Equal` ignores (e.g. toggle `mysql.NotNullFlag` while keeping unsigned the same). Assert either: (a) after switching to `RetType.Equals`, `Column.Equals` is false and hashes differ; or (b) if keeping partial equality, `Column.Equals` true and `Column.Hash64` sums equal.
findings.what: `Column.Hash64`/`Column.Equals` can violate the HashEquals contract (equal objects must hash the same) because `Equals` uses `FieldType.Equal` (partial comparison) while `Hash64` uses `FieldType.Hash64` (full-field hashing).

subject: planner: introduce hashEquals interface for expression.Expression (#55793)
summary: Embed cascades/base.HashEquals (Hash64/Equals) into `expression.Expression` and implement it for `Constant`, `ScalarFunction`, `CorrelatedColumn`, and planner `ScalarSubQueryExpr`; fix Column hash/equals to include `VirtualExpr`.
